design.stateDecoder: fixed reward-free log1p MBON centroids; no refit
design.bitDecoder: per-cue nearest Euclidean standardized-feature centroids; train repeats 0-5; test repeats 6-11
design.gates: target pair +1 mean spike/cue; bit decoder >=10/12 and >=5/6 per bit/cue; no-message state >=9/12/cue; messages >=8/12/cue and drop <=2/12
